biggest_catch: The only concrete standing amount is the SAM Lab's up to $100; other labs list no compensation, so earnings vary by lab and study.
catches: Only the Sleep, Stress, and Memory Lab states a concrete amount (up to $100); other listed labs publish no compensation
Actual study durations are not stated on the page; time range is an honest estimate

Undergraduates can also sign up through SONA, but SONA compensation is not specified on this page

c1.evidence: psychology.nd.edu (official University of Notre Dame Psychology department domain), 'Participate in Research' community page, live at verification time

c2.evidence: Official page states for the Sleep, Stress, and Memory (SAM) Lab: 'Depending on the study, participants will sleep in the lab and perform computer tasks and fill out questionnaires - payment up to $100 for participation'.

c3.evidence: Steps from official page: review the listed project descriptions, check whether you or family members are eligible, sign up through SONA (Notre Dame undergraduates) or contact the specific lab, participate in interviews/tasks/lab sessions, receive payment.

c4.evidence: No fee is mentioned; volunteer research participation is free.

eligibility: Varies by lab: pregnant women 16+ (BRAVE), children 6-8 with mothers (Development & Psychopathology), families with children 5-18 (Family Studies), St. Joseph County Mexican-origin families (Latino Adolescents lab), adults up to 59 (SAM), college-age adults (Visual Cognition)
notes: Standing multi-study participant recruitment hub of the University of Notre Dame Department of Psychology, listing six active research labs. Page is live on the current department site at verification time.
numeric_basis: Payout: concrete figure from official page is SAM Lab 'up to $100'; other labs publish no amount, so range is 0-100 with a note that only SAM Lab's amount is concrete. Active time: page gives no durations; 60-600 minutes is an honest typical-session estimate across labs (some studies include sleeping in the lab), explicitly flagged as estimated.
payout_value_note: Concrete standing amount stated only for the Sleep, Stress, and Memory Lab; other labs on the page do not publish compensation.

steps: Review the six project descriptions on the official page
Check eligibility criteria for the lab(s) of interest
Sign up through SONA (Notre Dame undergraduates) or contact the lab directly
